$comment: The submitted documents by level, from the prototype's catalog with Arabic aligned to the compliance form's attachment list. The plan carries its official Arabic name (SPEC 2b). State lives in the database; this is the catalog.

documents.noteEn: The certificate or policy itself. The insurance declaration on the compliance form cannot be made without it.
documents.noteAr: الشهادة أو البوليصة نفسها. ولا يمكن الإقرار بالتأمين في نموذج الامتثال من دونها.
documents.$commentEffective: Evidence of insurance became a required attachment on this date; before it, the compliance form asked whether evidence was attached and a typed answer satisfied it. The date is configuration, not the deploy date: a requirement that starts when the software happens to ship is a requirement nobody can plan for.

documents.en: EMS readiness declaration from each participating EMS provider
documents.ar: إقرار جاهزية الإسعاف من كل مزوّد إسعاف مشارك

$commentEffectiveFrom: A document with no effectiveFrom has always been required. One with a date applies from that date forward, per the Ministry ruling of 2026-08-29 -- see lib/rules/grandfathering.ts.
